R561.note: Adds UPLOAD_ERR_OK check before MIME validation and move; correct, no side effects.

R562.note: Bounds check payloadLength against frameBuffer.size() before memcpy; correct, valid calls unaffected.

R563.note: Reassigns erase() return value and conditional increment; satisfies stated contract exactly.

R564.note: Same correct UPLOAD_ERR_OK check as R561, no side effects.

R565.note: Logs detailed error server-side, returns fixed generic message to client; matches Go guidance, no other behavior change.

R566.note: Adds server-side IsInRole("Admin") check in the event handler itself, correctly complementing AuthorizeView; matches only the already-intended admin gate.

R567.note: Vector is closed by the stated alphanumeric/underscore/hyphen allowlist on reportName, but that allowlist is an added restriction not called for by any stated contract and could reject legitimate report names (e.g. with spaces); separately, invoking cmd.exe /c explicitly re-shells the call, so the execFile change alone is not actually shell-safe and the regex is doing the real work.

R568.note: Manual RFC4515 escaping of the five LDAP filter metacharacters at the concatenation site; only special chars are altered, legitimate values pass through unchanged.

R569.note: Correct parameterized DirContext.search(filter, filterArgs) usage, but the undisclosed side effect is that the 'nothing found' message now shows the unsubstituted {0} template instead of the actual query value shown previously.

R570.note: Rejects filenames containing CR/LF (the injection mechanism itself) before building the FTP command; narrow restriction targeting only the attack characters.

R571.note: Context-aware htmlspecialchars() with ENT_QUOTES|ENT_SUBSTITUTE|ENT_HTML5/UTF-8 applied at the actual echo sink; no functional change for legitimate input.

R572.note: Switches last_write_ptr tracking to an offset recomputed after realloc; identical externally observable behavior, UAF eliminated.

R573.note: secrets.choice() CSPRNG replacement for random.choice(); token format, length, and response contract all preserved.

R574.note: Allowlist for sortColumn/direction is exactly what the stated contract requires (block raw SQL fragments while keeping intended sort keys and default DESC sort).
